items.title: Fooled twice: People cannot detect deepfakes but think they can

judge.evidence_topic: Hyper-realistic manipulation of audio-visual content, i.e., deepfakes, presents a new challenge for establishing veracity of online content. Research on the human impact of deepfakes, addressing both behaviors in response to and cognitive processing of deepfakes, remains sparse.
judge.evidence_empirical: In a pre-registered behavioral experiment ( N = 210), we show that (a) people cannot reliably detect deepfakes
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico com participantes humanos sobre a detecção de deepfakes, atendendo a todos os critérios. Os dados extraídos refletem fielmente o resumo.

items.title: Deepfake detection by human crowds, machines, and machine-informed crowds

judge.evidence_topic: In two online studies with 15,016 participants, we present authentic videos and deepfakes and ask participants to identify which is which.
judge.evidence_empirical: In two online studies with 15,016 participants, we present authentic videos and deepfakes and ask participants to identify which is which.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico publicado em periódico revisado por pares (PNAS) dentro do período solicitado. O foco é a detecção humana de deepfakes, não sendo um estudo sobre algoritmos, política ou saúde. Os dados extraídos (tipo de estudo, método, amostra e achado) estão corretos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: AI-synthesized faces are indistinguishable from real faces and more trustworthy

judge.evidence_topic: Our evaluation of the photorealism of AI-synthesized faces indicates that synthesis engines have passed through the uncanny valley and are capable of creating faces that are indistinguishable-and more trustworthy-than real faces.
judge.evidence_empirical: Our evaluation of the photorealism of AI-synthesized faces indicates that synthesis engines have passed through the uncanny valley and are capable of creating faces that are indistinguishable-and more trustworthy-than real faces.
judge.reason: O resumo não menciona participantes ou experimentos, impossibilitando a verificação do método. O achado principal é sustentado pelo trecho: 'capable of creating faces that are indistinguishable-and more trustworthy-than real faces'.

items.title: AI Hyperrealism: Why AI Faces Are Perceived as More Real Than Human Ones

judge.evidence_topic: In Experiment 1 ( N = 124 adults), alongside our reanalysis of previously published data, we showed that White AI faces are judged as human more often than actual human faces—a phenomenon we term AI hyperrealism.
judge.evidence_empirical: In Experiment 1 ( N = 124 adults)... In Experiment 2 ( N = 610 adults)...
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico publicado em 2023 que investiga a percepção humana de rostos sintéticos, atendendo aos critérios de inclusão e exclusão. O método descrito e o achado principal estão alinhados com o resumo fornecido.

items.title: AI-generated images of familiar faces are indistinguishable from real photographs

judge.evidence_topic: Here, we investigated a new method for generating face images (via ChatGPT plus DALL·E) and its application to both fictional and real (in this case, celebrity) identities.
judge.evidence_empirical: Our results demonstrated that generated images of both fictional (Experiment 1) and celebrity identities (Experiment 2) could not be distinguished from real photographs.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico que utiliza experimentos para avaliar a percepção humana de imagens sintéticas, estando dentro do escopo solicitado. O método descrito nos dados extraídos reflete fielmente os experimentos mencionados no resumo. O achado principal é sustentado pelo texto do resumo.

items.title: Training human super-recognizers' detection and discrimination of AI-generated faces

judge.evidence_topic: Here, we investigate synthetic face detection and discrimination in super-recognizers (SRs; who have exceptional face recognition skills), and typical-ability control participants.
judge.evidence_empirical: In two different experimental designs, we found that SRs (total N = 283) were better at detecting and discriminating synthetic faces than controls (total N = 381)
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico experimental publicado em 2025 que investiga a capacidade humana de detectar rostos sintéticos, atendendo a todos os critérios de inclusão e exclusão. Os dados extraídos estão corretos e sustentados pelo resumo.

items.title: Providing detection strategies to improve human detection of deepfakes: An experimental study

judge.evidence_topic: In this preregistered online experiment, participants (N = 454, Mage = 37.19, SDage = 13.25, males = 57.5%) categorize a series of 20 videos as either real or deepfake.
judge.evidence_empirical: In this preregistered online experiment, participants (N = 454, Mage = 37.19, SDage = 13.25, males = 57.5%) categorize a series of 20 videos as either real or deepfake.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico experimental com participantes humanos sobre a detecção de deepfakes, publicado em periódico dentro do prazo estipulado. Os dados extraídos (tipo de estudo, método, amostra e achado principal) estão corretos e são sustentados pelo resumo fornecido.

items.title: Testing human ability to detect 'deepfake' images of human faces

judge.evidence_topic: This study aims to assess human ability to identify image deepfakes of human faces
judge.evidence_empirical: Using an online survey, participants (N = 280) were randomly allocated to one of four groups
judge.reason: O artigo aborda a detecção humana de deepfakes de rostos, sendo um estudo empírico com participantes humanos. O método descrito (survey/experimento online) está correto e o achado principal reflete fielmente o resumo.

items.title: Deepfake detection with and without content warnings

judge.evidence_topic: We conduct an experiment to measure people's alertness to and ability to detect a high-quality deepfake among a set of videos.
judge.evidence_empirical: We conduct an experiment to measure people's alertness to and ability to detect a high-quality deepfake among a set of videos.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico experimental sobre a detecção humana de deepfakes, atendendo aos critérios. Os dados extraídos estão corretos e sustentados pelo resumo, incluindo a ausência de informação sobre o tamanho da amostra no texto fornecido.

items.title: Conspiracy thinking and social media use are associated with ability to detect deepfakes

judge.evidence_topic: The aim of the current study was to investigate the predictors of human performance at recognizing deepfake videos.
judge.evidence_empirical: The aim of the current study was to investigate the predictors of human performance at recognizing deepfake videos. Our findings show that humans perform better at recognizing deepfake videos of familiar persons compared to deepfakes of unfamiliar persons.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico que investiga o desempenho humano na detecção de deepfakes, alinhando-se ao tema e aos critérios de inclusão. O método descrito nos dados extraídos é consistente com o objetivo de avaliar o desempenho humano na detecção de vídeos, e o achado principal é diretamente sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: Deepfake smiles matter less—the psychological and neural impact of presumed AI-generated faces

judge.evidence_topic: Here we investigate the impact of the belief that depicted persons are real or deepfakes on psychological and neural measures of human face perception.
judge.evidence_empirical: Using EEG, we tracked participants’ (N = 30) brain responses to real faces showing positive, neutral, and negative expressions, after being informed that they are either real or fake.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico experimental com humanos que investiga a percepção de rostos sintéticos, atendendo aos critérios de inclusão e exclusão. O método (EEG e avaliações) está descrito no resumo e o achado principal é sustentado pelo texto.

items.title: Real and Deepfake Face Recognition: An EEG Study on Cognitive and Emotive Implications

judge.evidence_topic: This study investigated healthy individuals' cognitive and emotional engagement in a visual discrimination task involving real and deepfake human faces expressing positive, negative, or neutral emotions.
judge.evidence_empirical: Electroencephalographic (EEG) data were collected from 23 healthy participants using a 21-channel dry-EEG headset; power spectrum and event-related potential (ERP) analyses were performed.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico com participantes humanos sobre a percepção de deepfakes, não se enquadrando nas exclusões (saúde, política, algoritmos). O achado principal é sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: Are you for real? Decoding realistic AI-generated faces from neural activity

judge.evidence_topic: We investigated how the human brain encodes and interprets realistic artificially generated images using behaviour and brain imaging.
judge.evidence_empirical: We investigated how the human brain encodes and interprets realistic artificially generated images using behaviour and brain imaging.
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico com participantes humanos que investiga a percepção de rostos gerados por IA, alinhando-se ao tema. Os métodos (comportamento e neuroimagem) e os achados (decodificação neural e confusão comportamental) estão corretamente descritos.

items.title: Cortical-striatal brain network distinguishes deepfake from real speaker identity

judge.evidence_topic: We test the neurocognitive sensitivity of 25 participants to accept or reject person identities as recreated in audio deepfakes.
judge.evidence_empirical: We test the neurocognitive sensitivity of 25 participants to accept or reject person identities as recreated in audio deepfakes.
judge.reason: O artigo investiga a percepção humana de vozes deepfake, atendendo ao tema. É um estudo empírico com 25 participantes. O método de fMRI e tarefa comportamental é condizente com o resumo. O achado principal é sustentado pelo resumo.

items.title: People are poorly equipped to detect AI-powered voice clones

judge.evidence_topic: Through a series of perceptual studies, we report on the realism of AI-generated voices in terms of identity matching and naturalness.
judge.evidence_empirical: Through a series of perceptual studies, we report on the realism of AI-generated voices in terms of identity matching and naturalness.

items.title: Voice clones sound realistic but not (yet) hyperrealistic

judge.evidence_topic: We investigated the extent to which AI-generated voices sound real to human listeners, and whether listeners can accurately distinguish between human and AI-generated voices.
judge.evidence_empirical: Here, we tested whether a 'hyperrealism effect' also exists for AI-generated voices. We investigated the extent to which AI-generated voices sound real to human listeners
judge.reason: O artigo é um estudo empírico publicado em periódico (PLOS One) em 2025 que investiga a percepção humana de vozes geradas por IA, atendendo aos critérios. Os dados extraídos estão corretos e sustentados pelo resumo.
